ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the entities involved and the amounts of money at stake
questions: What are the specifics of the Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant corruption and fraud, and could lead to further investigations and reforms. I would start by analyzing publicly available data on Medicaid spending in Minnesota, and then follow up with sources at CMS and the state government.
